name: vero-plugins
description: VeroDiff, VeroDotto, VeroRunto, VeroInserto: Claude Code plugins in one marketplace

plugins.name: vero-diff
plugins.description: One turn, one diff. See exactly what Claude changed on each turn, and undo it

plugins.name: vero-dotto
plugins.description: Read true. Spend less. Claude reads docx, pdf, spreadsheets and OpenDocument as clean markdown

plugins.name: vero-runto
plugins.description: Click. Run. Done. Copy and Run buttons after every ! command Claude suggests; Run goes through Claude Code's Bash tool under your permission rules

plugins.name: vero-inserto
plugins.description: From tree to prompt. Type @@, pick a file or folder from your project tree, and its @path lands at the cursor
